details: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee advanced the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (H.R. 3633) with a bipartisan 15-9 vote, sending the comprehensive crypto regulatory bill to the full Senate. This legislation aims to create a clear federal framework by delineating oversight between the SEC and CFTC for digital assets, a significant step towards regulatory clarity for the cryptocurrency industry.
title: US Senate Committee Advances Key Crypto Bill

details: CME Group has announced that XRP will be included in its new Nasdaq Crypto Index futures, set to launch on June 8, 2026. This move is anticipated to enhance institutional exposure and liquidity for XRP. Additionally, CME will shift all its crypto products to 24/7 trading starting May 29, further integrating digital assets into traditional financial markets.
title: XRP Joins CME Nasdaq Crypto Index, 24/7 Trading Incoming

details: Bitcoin briefly surged past $82,000 following optimism from the CLARITY Act's advancement but has since seen a slight pullback, trading around $81,000. The broader crypto market experienced some consolidation, with Bitcoin's price reflecting both positive regulatory developments and general market movements.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Around $81K Amid Mixed Signals

details: The Ethereum Foundation has unstaked approximately 21,270 ETH, valued at about $49.6 million, from Lido's liquid staking protocol. This action is part of the foundation's ongoing treasury adjustments, which also included a previous unstaking in late April and a sale of 10,000 ETH to Bitmine. The move is viewed as a strategic shift for liquidity or network development, though it has generated some community uncertainty.
title: Ethereum Foundation Unstakes $49.6M ETH from Lido

details: Binance Research forecasts that tokenized stocks alone could become a $1.3 trillion market opportunity, driven by benefits such as 24/7 trading, fractional ownership, and reduced fees. This projection aligns with the significant growth observed in the broader tokenized real-world assets (RWA) market, which has already exceeded $27 billion in 2026, highlighting increasing integration between traditional finance and blockchain technology.
title: Tokenized Assets Projected for Trillion-Dollar Growth
